description: This Java class 'EntityCacheServices' provides cache management services for entities in the Apache OFBiz framework, including methods for clearing cache lines and managing distributed cache invalidation.

classes.name: EntityCacheServices
classes.description: Provides cache clearing services for entity cache management, including distributed cache invalidation.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Initializes the delegator, dispatcher, and user login ID for cache operations.

methods.name: getAuthUserLogin
methods.description: Retrieves the authenticated user login information from the database.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLine
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache line based on a specific value.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineFlexible
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache line based on a dummy primary key.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineByCondition
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache line based on an entity condition.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLine
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache line based on a primary key.

methods.name: clearAllCaches
methods.description: Clears all entity caches, optionally distributing the cache clear.

methods.name: clearAllEntityCaches
methods.description: Service method to clear all entity caches, with optional distribution.

methods.name: clearCacheLine
methods.description: Service method to clear a specific cache line based on value, dummyPK, primaryKey, or condition.
